documents.text: Richard J. Seitz Lieutenant General Richard "Dick" Joe Seitz (February 18, 1918 – June 8, 2013) was an American Army officer and paratrooper who, during a 35-year career, commanded the 2nd Battalion, 517th Parachute Infantry Regiment during World War II, the 82nd Airborne Division and the XVIII Airborne Corps. Seitz and his brother, Brigadier General John A. "Andy" Seitz, both graduated from Leavenworth High School in Leavenworth, Kansas.
